No option can be put forward yet: the model could not test the **annual salary spend ≤ £400k/year** limit, so it was excluded from the comparison.

- The comparison is also **very low robustness** and all options produced nearly identical outcomes. Its strongest driver is delivery capacity, but this is an Olumi estimate rather than user-supplied evidence.
- The run assumed that a higher “new platform delivery by Q3” value is better; that objective direction was not explicitly stated.
- The £400k cap needs to be attached to a comparable measured salary-spend quantity; as modelled, annual spend is calculated from other factors and cannot be checked against the limit.
